decisions: Module implementation keys consume source implementation, ambient standard-library interfaces, complete type universe, actual emission-set hashes and transitive dependency interfaces in the generated rule order.
Modules represented only in emissions receive the generated synthetic interface and implementation rules.
Whole interface preserves canonical source catalog order; whole implementation sorts all source and synthetic keys by stable identity and full ordinal name.
Prefix and suffix keys consume the corresponding whole keys through their distinct generated rules.
The composer accepts explicit real emission facts; native emission identity discovery and production lookup/reuse/publication remain separate required work.
initialProofScope: Actual unmodified CSharp Open observed before the first SLG composition edit; current observer proof refreshed after adding the explicit emission-only projection mode.
